## About this app

_arrow\_forward_

Make getting around easier with Bolt! Whether you need a ride across town, an airport transfer, or a scooter to zip through traffic, our app makes it easy to move around confidently and conveniently.  
  
WHY CHOOSE BOLT?  
\- Request a ride in seconds: enjoy safe, affordable rides with top-rated drivers.  
\- Transparent pricing: see your fare upfront so there are no surprises.  
\- Multiple payment options: pay securely using a credit/debit card, Google Pay, or cash.  
  
EASY ORDERING:  
\- Open the app and set your destination.  
\- Choose from various ride types to suit your needs (Comfort, Premium, Electric, XL, and more).  
\- Track your driver in real time.  
\- Arrive in comfort and rate your experience.  
  
SAFETY FIRST:  
Some of Bolt’s safety features require the app to run in the background.  
  
\- Emergency assist button: discreetly alert our Safety Team in case of emergencies.  
\- Audio trip recording: record audio during rides for added peace of mind.  
\- Private phone details: your contact information stays confidential when you call a driver.  
  
PLAN AHEAD:  
Need an airport transfer or an early morning ride? You can schedule your trip in advance from 30 minutes to 90 days before your expected pickup time.  
  
\*JOIN BOLT PLUS TO UNLOCK PREMIUM FEATURES!  
Get the best of Bolt with Bolt Plus. Enjoy exclusive perks that save you time and money, making every ride smoother and more convenient.  
  
\*BOLT DRIVE:  
We're committed to our carbon net zero goal by 2040. That's why we're increasing the lineup of electric and hybrid cars in Bolt Drive, our car-sharing service. You can also rent Bolt scooters and e-bikes via the app.  
  
\*DELIVER PACKAGES  
Use the 'Send' ride type to arrange fast and convenient parcel delivery in your city.  
  
The app provides a seamless ride-ordering experience whether you’re commuting, travelling, or running errands. So, the next time you need a ride, choose Bolt!  
  
\*Bolt options differ by location. Check the app for availability in your city.  
  
Earn money driving with the Bolt Driver app. Sign up: https://bolt.eu/driver/  
  
Questions? Get in touch via info@bolt.eu or at https://bolt.eu  
  
Follow us on social media for updates, discounts, and offers!  
  
Facebook — https://www.facebook.com/Bolt/  
Instagram — https://www.instagram.com/bolt  
X — https://x.com/Boltapp

Bolt.new Review 2026: Features, Pricing, Limits & Alternatives

# Bolt.new AI - Transform Prompts into Full-Stack Apps Instantly

![Bolt.new AI-powered full-stack app builder](https://static.seaflux.tech/media/blog/5d46b4b5-57a8-41e9-9c4d-66b8c2272474-physical-asset-25-.png)

## Bolt.new at a Glance

Bolt.new is an AI-powered, browser-based app builder from StackBlitz. You describe what you want in plain English, and it generates a working full-stack web app that you can preview, edit, and publish from the browser, with no local setup. It is best suited to prototypes, MVPs, and internal tools, and its pricing is based on tokens, so costs depend on how much you build and revise. This review covers its features, current pricing, limits, and how it compares with v0, Lovable, and Replit Agent.

## Quick Verdict

*   **Best for:** founders, product teams, and developers who want to turn an idea into a working prototype quickly.
*   **Less suited to:** production systems that need custom architecture, strict security reviews, or predictable costs. For that decision, see our guide to [custom software vs off-the-shelf](https://www.seaflux.tech/blogs/custom-software-vs-off-the-shelf/).
*   **Watch out for:** token usage on large or heavily revised apps, and the need to review generated code before it handles real users or data.
*   **Cost:** free to start, with paid plans from $25 per month. Confirm current figures on Bolt’s pricing page.

## What Is Bolt.new AI?

Bolt.new AI (also known as Bolt AI) is a chat-driven, browser-native development tool powered by StackBlitz’s WebContainers.  Anyone from non-technical users to developers can create, edit, preview, and deploy web applications, and mobile apps for iOS and Android through Expo, using just natural language prompts. It handles frontend, backend, and database logic from a single chat, and a first working prototype typically takes minutes, though refining it takes longer.

## Key Features

*   **AI Code Generation:** Prompts such as “Create a CRM with a Kanban board” are turned into a working full-stack app you can preview immediately.
*   **In-Browser IDE (WebContainers):** A live preview, terminal, package installs, and a code editor, with nothing to set up locally.
*   **Framework and Tool Support:** Works with popular frameworks such as React, Vue, Next.js, Astro, Svelte, and Remix, and integrates with services such as Supabase, Stripe, and GitHub.
*   **Publishing and Hosting:** Publish from the browser, including Bolt’s built-in hosting, or deploy through platforms such as Netlify or Vercel. Hosting and database allowances vary by plan, so check the current limits.
*   **Mobile Apps with Expo:** Ask for a mobile app and Bolt uses Expo (React Native) to target iOS and Android from one codebase. You preview with Expo Go, and publishing to the app stores goes through Expo’s build services.
*   **Editable Code:** Everything generated can be edited directly in the in-browser editor.

## Benefits

*   **Fast prototyping:** go from an idea to a working MVP in minutes, then refine it.
*   **Accessible to many roles:** non-technical founders can test ideas, and developers can skip repetitive scaffolding.
*   **One-tab workflow:** design, build, preview, and publish without switching tools.
*   **Editable output:** the generated code is yours to review and change.
*   **Low cost to start:** a free plan lets you evaluate it before paying.

## Practical Use Cases

*   MVPs & Concept Testing: Useful for validating product ideas quickly. See our [AI MVP development guide](https://www.seaflux.tech/blogs/ai-mvp-app-development-guide/) for what to do after the prototype.
*   Learning & Experimentation: Great sandbox for educational purposes and hackathons.
*   AI-Powered Apps: Create chatbots, GPT-based agents, or other AI-enhanced tools, and connect payments through integrations such as Stripe.
*   “Vibe Coding”: Chat-style building that bypasses traditional coding processes for intuitive prototyping.

## Bolt.new Pricing in 2026

Bolt.new charges by tokens, which are consumed as the AI reads and writes code, not by seats or prompts. The plans below were listed at the time of writing, so confirm current figures on Bolt’s pricing page.

| **Plan** | **Price** | **Tokens** | **Notable limits and features** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Free | $0  | 1M per month, 300K per day | Bolt branding, 10 MB uploads, limited hosting |
| Pro | From $25 per month | From 10M per month, no daily cap | Custom domains, no Bolt branding, larger uploads, token rollover |
| Teams | $30 per member per month | Per member, not pooled | Centralized billing and admin controls |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Contact Bolt |

Higher Pro tiers with larger token allowances also exist. Because Bolt does not publish how many tokens a typical prompt uses, costs are hard to forecast for large apps or long sessions.

## Comparison with Similar Tools

| **Tool** | **Best for** | **Strengths** | **Watch-outs** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Bolt.new** | Fast browser-based prototyping | Code-first full-stack apps with an in-browser IDE | Token costs, context limits, output often needs review before production |
| **v0 (Vercel)** | Next.js and Vercel teams | UI components and full-stack Next.js apps | Tied to the Vercel ecosystem |
| **Lovable** | Non-technical founders building web apps | Conversational and visual full-stack creation with a Supabase backend | Credit-based pricing, backend setup depends on Supabase |
| **Replit Agent** | People who want to read and edit the code in a full IDE | Built-in database and deployments in one cloud workspace | Usage costs can rise |

Cursor and GitHub Copilot are editor-level coding assistants rather than app builders, so they suit developers working in an existing codebase. Capabilities in this category change quickly, so check each provider’s site before deciding.

## Limitations & Considerations

*   **Token-based pricing:** Bolt bills in tokens, not prompts, and does not publish a tokens-per-prompt figure, so large or heavily revised apps can cost more than the plan price suggests.
*   **Context loss:** very long sessions can lose track of earlier decisions.
*   **Customization effort:** complex UI or business logic often needs manual changes.
*   **Code quality varies:** generated apps work as demos, but should be reviewed and cleaned up before they scale or handle real user data.
*   **Browser resource limits:** very large projects can run into performance bottlenecks.
*   **AI inaccuracies:** generated code and content can contain mistakes, so always review them.

Bolt.new is great for prototypes. Production-grade applications need security reviews, scalable architecture, testing, and monitoring, which is where an engineering team comes in. [See our work](https://www.seaflux.tech/portfolio/) or read our guide to [building an MVP with AI](https://www.seaflux.tech/blogs/ai-mvp-app-development-guide/).

### It's all in the details

![Symfony ](/files/symfony-black-03.png)

#### Symfony 5 extensions

There’s no limit to the functionality you can incorporate in your Bolt project. At its core, Bolt is a Symfony application, so you can use the tools provided by the framework.

![Twig](/files/branch.svg)

#### Twig templates

There's a reason why Twig is the de-facto standard across the PHP community. It is flexible, fast and secure. Take a look how easy it is to generate the HTML for your pages.

![Built-in internationalisation ](/files/translating.svg)

#### Built-in internationalisation

Need more languages? No problem, it's just one line of code. The even cooler thing? With field-level control you can decide _exactly_ which parts of the page will be translated.

![API](/files/jack-in-the-box.svg)

#### Out-of-the-box API

Bolt provides a RESTful and GraphQL API. No extra configuration needed. Use the CMS in headless mode, alongside a static site generator, or simply to feed data into whatever other platform.

![Dummy content](/files/dummy.svg)

#### Dummy content

Dummy content. You need it to test, or to showcase your work to your clients. Putting it in there is tiresome, though. Good news: not anymore. All you need to do is use one single line of code.

![Content editors](/files/content.svg)

#### Best rich content editors

You get the best content editors: Article and Redactor. Fully licensed for use in Bolt itself. For free. With love. Because we believe creating and adapting content should be easy. Period.
